tour.step1_copy: Park your heavy workflows and models safely on your secondary storage drive. Keep your fast SSD clean without having to delete your collection.
tour.step1_highlight: Deduplicated shared pool: Multiple workflows share identical checkpoints and LoRAs automatically.
tour.step2_copy: With a single click, ComfyShelf links all required models via NTFS hardlinks or Windows symlinks into ComfyUI in milliseconds.
tour.step2_highlight: Zero 15-minute file copy transfers and zero duplicate disk consumption.
tour.step3_copy: Simply drag & drop generated PNG images into ComfyShelf to archive them. When loaded, click 'Copy workflow' and hit Ctrl+V in your open ComfyUI tab.
tour.step3_highlight: The complete node graph drops right onto your canvas — zero tab reload friction.
tour.step4_copy: Need fast disk space back? Unload workflows with confidence. ComfyShelf verifies SHA-256 hashes against your archive before removing any local files.
tour.step4_highlight: Collision protection: Models still needed by other active workflows are protected automatically.
